user.title: Call Webhook
user.description: Adds the Call Webhook: Send action. Each automation sets its own URL, token, and body. Nothing else is stored here.

abort.already_configured: Call Webhook is already set up. One instance covers every webhook.

send.name: Send
send.description: Send an HTTP request to a webhook URL.

url.name: URL
url.description: Webhook URL. http and https only.

bearer_token.name: Bearer token
bearer_token.description: Sent as Authorization: Bearer when filled in. Typed on this action. Home Assistant stores it in the automation.

data.name: Data
data.description: JSON object. Templates are rendered by the automation before the request. POST, PUT, PATCH, and DELETE send it as the body. GET sends it as query parameters.

headers.name: Headers
headers.description: Extra request headers. Authorization from Bearer token and Content-Type for a JSON body replace matching headers.

timeout.name: Timeout
timeout.description: How long to wait, in seconds. Defaults to 10. Maximum 300.

verify_ssl.name: Verify SSL
verify_ssl.description: Verify the server TLS certificate. Defaults to on.
